subject: general
question: A taxi goes from city P to city Q at an average speed of 60 km/h. On the return journey, due to traffic, the average speed of the taxi falls by 20 km/h. Find the average speed of a taxi (in km/h) for the entire journey.
solution:
**Given:**

A taxi travels from city P to city Q at an average speed of 60 km/h. On the return journey, the average speed decreases by 20 km/h due to traffic.

**Concept Used:**

The average speed for the entire journey can be found using the formula:

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

**Formula Used:**

Total Distance = Distance from P to Q + Distance from Q to P

Total Time = Time take
